shows: 群組後果 gcons[node][hurt]：同學在群組轉述外人的話（不出現外人轉傳畫面）

D.who 已退群 → 不出後果畫面

verdict = gone if len(gone)>=2 else self if self>=3 and no gone else mix

ask.en: You crop this one: Penny taking leave, or you staying behind?

h1.en: Unpaid parental leave by the day

sub.zh: 彈性陪伴 工作家庭兩相顧
sub.en: Flexible Care, Work and Family in Balance

aside.en: Apologized once more before leaving

h1.en: Thanks to every one of you who stepped in

sub.zh: 職務代理 一起撐

aside.en: Two rings on the table

group.zh: 明天請育嬰留停一天，孩子打疫苗，不好意思
group.en: Sorry, taking one day of unpaid parental leave tomorrow for my kid's vaccination

group.zh: 顏座，我的案子先放妳那🙏
group.en: Boss Vivian, please hold my case 🙏

group.zh: 真好，我當年只能一次請完
group.en: Nice, I had to take all my parental leave at once

group.zh: 老顏又要加班了吧
group.en: Vivian's on overtime again huh

group.zh: 老顏妳也要請假啊
group.en: Vivian you should take leave too

1.zh: 組長拿那張堵我，問那案子要丟給誰
1.en: My team lead held up that poster and asked who's going to handle the case

1.zh: 請一天育嬰留停，考績上就被記一筆了，不好意思
1.en: One day of unpaid parental leave, and it's on my performance review. Sorry

1.zh: 老顏，我的案子先放在妳的桌上🙏
1.en: Vivian, I’m leaving my case on your desk for now 🙏

self.zh: 同學都留在畫面裡，妳的生活被裁掉了
self.en: Everyone stayed in the picture. Your life got cropped.

gone.zh: 宣傳照張張漂亮，天燈少了好幾盞
gone.en: Every poster looked great. Several lanterns never went up.

mix.en: No one was spared, not even you.

家豪: 喜酒那天，我要坐第一桌，哈哈哈
At your wedding, I get the first table, hahaha

阿芳: 七點前到家，飯還是熱的啦😝
Get home by seven, while it's still hot 😝
佩珊: 七點以後的案子，交給我這邊，不好意思
Anything after seven, leave it with me, sorry

宜君: 寶寶的乾媽，算我一個啦QQ
Count me in as the baby's godmom QQ
佩珊: 我家孩子的舊衣服，全部留給寶寶，不好意思
All my kid's old clothes go to your baby, sorry

阿芳: 戴回去那天，記得傳照片到群組啦😝
When they're back on, send the group a photo 😝
佩珊: 戴回去那天的照片，我要第一張，不好意思
When they're back on, I want the first photo, sorry
妳把人牽回來，這次換我幫妳拍照，不好意思啦！
Bring her back, and this time I'm taking the photo. Sorry!

rep: 這張我私訊傳給{n}了，不好意思
I sent this one to {n} directly, sorry

佩珊: 收到，以後妳的案子放我桌上，不好意思
Got it. From now on, your cases go on my desk, sorry
家豪: 收到，下次補漆的刷子，有妳一支，哈哈哈
Got it. Next repaint, one brush is yours, hahaha
阿芳: 收到啦，下次見面我帶小芋頭一起😝
Got it. Next time we meet, I'm bringing Little Taro 😝
宜君: 收到啦，富士山那趟，妳也一起啦QQ
Got it. When I do Mt. Fuji, you're coming too QQ

家豪: 說好了，八年後誰都不能缺席，哈哈哈
Deal. In eight years, nobody skips, hahaha
佩珊: 八年後，我們再來這裡拍一張，不好意思
In eight years, let's take another one here, sorry
八年後，我們再來這裡拍一張，不好意思
In eight years, let's take another one here, sorry

阿芳: 升主任了。小芋頭下午有人接，不是我。
Made director. Someone picks up Little Taro afternoons, not me.
回事務所了，主任沒升。小芋頭會自己走回家了。
Back at the office, no promotion. Little Taro walks home alone now.
家豪: 小太陽四十八個，招牌還亮著。
Little Sun has 48 kids, sign still shining.
小太陽剩三十個。招牌我自己補漆。
Little Sun down to 30. I repaint the sign myself.
宜君: 薪水三萬二。暑假帶媽看富士山，假單只准三天啦。
32,000. Taking Mom to Mt. Fuji this summer, only got 3 days off.
三萬了。富士山，明年一定排進行程啦。
30,000. Mt. Fuji, next year for sure.
志豪: 還沒存到八十萬，下個月先求婚。戒指拿出抽屜了。
Haven't saved 800k yet, proposing next month. Ring's out of the drawer.
還在存。小雯說她不急，我急。
Still saving. Wendy says she's not rushed, I am.
佩珊: 孩子會叫媽媽了。請假單還是先寫不好意思。
Baby says mama now. Still start my leave note with sorry.
請假還是會道歉。孩子很好。
Still apologize for leave. Kid's doing good.

阿芳: 小芋頭明年抽到公幼。我回事務所上班，三十五歲升主任。
Little Taro wins the lottery for a cheap public preschool next year. I go back to the firm and make manager by 35.
家豪: 小太陽幼兒園招生滿 60 個。爸寫的招牌要撐過第 30 年。
“Little Sun” fills all 60 places. Dad’s hand-painted sign makes it to year 30.
宜君: 月薪到 30,000。暑假帶我媽去富士山，機票我都先買好了啦。
Pay goes to 30K a month. Taking Mom to Mt. Fuji this summer, tickets already booked.
志豪: 九點前下班。存到 80 萬頭期款，到時跟小雯求婚。
Off work before 9. Save an 800k down payment, then I can finally propose to Wendy.
佩珊: 三十歲前生第一個。請假不用跟任何人道歉。
First baby before 30. Taking leave without apologizing to anyone.
